methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Blitzpanel is a pre-seed stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Ho. The relevant peer universe comprises 10 companies in Robotics & Manufacturing, including 1 public entity (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms such as Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. While 10 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filtering criteria—same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier—yielded fewer than three datapoints in any single cohort. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of robotics and manufacturing valuations across stages and business models. This constraint reflects the early stage of the target and the sparsity of directly comparable pre-seed transactions in this sector.

Without a sufficiently populated comparable set, triangulation cannot be completed using market-based methods. A defensible valuation range cannot be derived from the available data. Alternative approaches—including founder background and experience analysis, bottom-up revenue projections, or risk-adjusted discount rate modeling—would be required to establish an initial valuation hypothesis. The key uncertainty is the absence of transaction precedent at this stage and subsector, limiting anchor points for pricing.
